label: Own-nature ESSENCE_6 exclusions at a root are carried by what it REQUIRES_LACK_2 in itself
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred (LE_in): for every actual concrete root r at w, every ESSENCE_6 condition in r's own nature on r's profile holds at every admissible profile q containing r's real determinations in which no determination of r requires, in r (REQUIRES_LACK_2), the lack of some members of q. A bare negative clause 'lacks noesis' in a simple root's one nature, carried in the root by that nature, satisfies it; with the necessity direction of member grounding it does not give E (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clause 3).
